customer.business: Moduo: an all-in-one workspace (tasks, notes, calendar, contacts, email), pitched as a client hub for solo service businesses
customer.target: Solo freelancers and consultants (designers, developers, writers, coaches) who juggle several clients across 4+ separate apps
customer.where: Online; mostly US, UK and EU

segments.name: Solo founder of a small service business

behaviours.name: Notion tinkerer
behaviours.how: Has built their own client system in Notion and keeps rebuilding it.

behaviours.name: Tool-stack loyalist
behaviours.how: Pays for Spark, Todoist and Calendly and is fine with how they fit together.

behaviours.name: Subscription trimmer
behaviours.how: Audits their subscriptions every few months and cancels anything they don't use weekly.

behaviours.name: Inbox-as-to-do-list
behaviours.how: Runs their work from email stars and flags; forgets follow-ups.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Won't try a new tool without Reddit threads and reviews saying it's stable.

behaviours.name: Freelancer-suite user
behaviours.how: Runs clients and invoices in HoneyBook, Dubsado or Bonsai and tracks time in Toggl or Harvest.

behaviours.name: Early adopter
behaviours.how: Tries new productivity apps on launch day, rarely sticks with one.

objections: All-in-one apps are mediocre at everything; I'd still need my real email client
Moving my clients, notes and tasks over is a weekend I don't have
No time tracking or invoicing, so I'd still need Toggl and my invoicing tool
A new startup could shut down and take my data with it
I already pay for tools that work well enough
My email is on Outlook / Microsoft 365
I don't want my client email synced to someone else's cloud
$12 a month on top of what I already pay
habits: you have five active clients and two waiting on a proposal
you lost a follow-up email last month and nearly lost the client
you invoice at the end of every month from a spreadsheet
you work from home and a café two days a week
you check email first thing and it decides your day
customer._notes: Segments and objections draw on .design/tasks-dogfood/research-2026-10/segments.md (1a, 1b) and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md risks. Income ranges and behaviour shares are guesses; correct them before dealing. Founders' review 2026-10-19: lowered the designer income floor to $25k, swapped 'Paper and calendar' for a freelancer-suite user, added the time-tracking/invoicing objection, reworded the Outlook objection.

pitch:
Moduo, a desktop and web app for freelancers and consultants who run their business across email, a calendar, a notes app, a task app and a spreadsheet of clients.
It puts your email, tasks, calendar, notes and contacts in one app. Turn an email into a task in one click and it's linked to that client. Open a client and you see every email, task, note and meeting with them, without logging anything.
Works with Gmail and other IMAP email, and with iCloud, Fastmail or any CalDAV calendar. Outlook email isn't supported yet.
$12 a month for one person. Free plan with one workspace. 14-day trial with no card, 30 days if you add one.
Export all your data any time.
